name: Gold Ring
description: Guidelines for traveling with gold ring in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Valuable jewelry like gold rings should be kept in carry-on bags or worn during travel. Checked bags run a high risk of theft or loss.
conditions: You do not need to remove fine jewelry (rings, earrings) during screening unless they are exceptionally large metal pieces.
